title: The Scorched
description: Explore a volcanic wasteland where the Overworld has been burned into ash and magma. The Scorched adds a dangerous new biome, custom mobs, unique blocks, structures, and progression elements built around survival in a hostile scorched landscape.
body:
# The Scorched

[![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-Ko--fi-ff5f5f?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/gamemech007)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-The%20Scorched-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/GameMech007-git/The-Scorched)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-ISSUES-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/GameMech007-git/The-Scorched/issues)

**The Scorched** is a Minecraft mod that adds a dangerous volcanic wasteland to the Overworld.
Explore burned landscapes made of blackstone, basalt, tuff, magma, and ash-like terrain while discovering new blocks, creatures, structures, quests, and survival-focused progression.

---

## Overview

The Scorched transforms parts of the Overworld into a harsh, volcanic biome filled with heat, stone, and danger.
The biome is designed to feel close to vanilla Minecraft while still giving players a fresh reason to explore.

In this burned land, players can find scorched terrain, hostile creatures, Ashbound structures, unique blocks, new materials such as **Cinder Membrane**, and mysterious Ashbound inhabitants who guide players through quests.

---

## Features

* Adds a new volcanic Overworld biome: **The Scorched**
* Custom terrain made with blackstone, basalt, tuff, and magma blocks
* New biome atmosphere with custom sky, fog, water, grass, and foliage colors
* New items such as **Cinder Membrane**
* New blocks including:

  * **Scorched Shrub**
  * **Ashbound Chest**
  * **Scorched Forge**
* Custom Ashbound-themed structures
* New biome-themed mob concepts such as the **Cinderling**
* Adds the **Ashbound Forger**, a special villager-like NPC
* Quest-based progression through tasks given by the Ashbound Forger
* Designed to blend with Minecraft’s vanilla survival and exploration style

---

## The Scorched Biome

The Scorched is a dry, burned region where the Overworld has been consumed by volcanic heat.
Instead of normal grass, dirt, and stone, the land is covered in dark volcanic blocks, patches of magma, and rough basalt formations.

This biome is meant to feel dangerous, mysterious, and rewarding to explore.

---

## Ashbound Forger

The **Ashbound Forger** is a special NPC found within the Scorched lands.
Unlike a normal villager, the Ashbound Forger does not focus on regular trading. Instead, it gives the player tasks and guides them through the mysteries of the Scorched biome.

When players first interact with the Ashbound Forger, they can receive a task book. As the player completes objectives, the book can update with new tasks, allowing progression to continue over time.

The Ashbound Forger is designed to act as the heart of the mod’s progression system, connecting exploration, survival, structures, and rewards together.

---

## Cinder Membrane

**Cinder Membrane** is a new material connected to creatures adapted to the Scorched biome.
It can be used as part of the mod’s progression and may serve as a volcanic alternative to rare survival materials.

---

## Ashbound Content

The mod also introduces Ashbound-themed blocks, structures, and progression elements.
These are connected to the strange inhabitants and history of the Scorched lands.

Players may encounter Ashbound structures while exploring and discover special blocks such as the **Ashbound Chest** and **Scorched Forge**.

---

## Goal of the Mod

The goal of **The Scorched** is to add a biome that feels like it belongs in Minecraft, while still making exploration more exciting.

It is not just a visual biome.
The Scorched is planned as a complete survival area with its own atmosphere, resources, mobs, structures, NPCs, quests, and progression.

---

## Current Status

The mod is currently in development.
More features, mobs, structures, blocks, quests, and gameplay systems are planned for future updates.

---

> Enjoying The Scorched? Consider supporting development on Ko-fi to help fund future updates, mobs, structures, quests, and new features.
